beneficialOwners.subject: Beneficial Owners
beneficialOwners.intro: For legal reasons, we must ask for the beneficial owners of the company you represent. Please enter here all natural persons who own more than 25% of the capital or voting rights of the company.

alert.title: The beneficial owner is:
list: the natural person who ultimately owns or controls a legal entity, or
the natural person at whose instigation a transaction is ultimately carried out or a business relationship is ultimately established.
alert.p1: This includes any natural person who directly or indirectly holds more than 25% of the capital shares, controls more than 25% of the voting rights or exercises control in a comparable manner.
alert.p2: If the structure of the company is such that a natural person does not meet these requirements at the direct shareholding level, the company structure must be analyzed comprehensively until one or more natural persons are identified. If there are several beneficial owners, they must all be listed.
alert.p3: The 25% threshold no longer applies from the second level of participation in the contractual partner. In this case, a shareholding must be pursued further if control can actually be exercised over the respective direct participant. Accordingly, an indirect participant exercises control if it ultimately holds more than 50% of the capital shares in the relevant direct participant, controls more than 50% of the voting rights or can exercise a controlling influence.

wphg.title: Experience & level of knowledge
wphg.subtitle: Tell us about your experience
wphg.p1:
We are legally obliged to assess whether an investment in a financial instrument offered here is appropriate for our investors (appropriateness test). For this purpose, we ask you to answer the following questions accurately and completely. If you do not wish to share information with us, an investment is possible, but we cannot assess whether it is appropriate for you.
Please note: This appropriateness check does not constitute an individual recommendation as to whether the selected financial instrument is actually suitable for you (unlike investment advice). It is merely an assessment of whether you can judge the risks associated with the product based on your knowledge or experience in our opinion. Thank you for your answers and your trust.
wphg.p2: Professional clients under the German Securities Trading Act are deemed to have sufficient experience or knowledge to be able to properly assess the risks associated with the investment.

professional.title: Classification as a professional customer

p1.0: Investment amounts over €25,000 can currently only be invested by professional clients. A professional client is assumed to have sufficient knowledge and/or experience. If, as an investor, you meet at least two of the following three criteria, you can apply to be classified as a professional client under the Securities Trading Act (WpHG). Please answer the following questions truthfully.
p1.1: Investment amounts over the amount of € 25,000 can currently only be invested by professional customer. A professional client is deemed to have sufficient knowledge and/or experience. If the company fulfills at least two of the following three criteria, it is considered a professional client according to the German Securities Trading Act (WHG) and is classified accordingly. Please answer the following questions truthfully.

professional.p2: A change of classification can only be considered if the private customer fulfills at least two of the following three criteria:

requirements.title: transactions
requirements.text: The customer has carried out an average of ten transactions of significant size per quarter during the last year on the market on which the financial instruments are traded for which he is to be classified as a professional customer

requirements.title: assets
requirements.text: The customer has bank deposits and financial instruments with a value of more than 500,000 euros

requirements.title: experience
requirements.text: The customer has practiced a profession in the capital market for at least one year that requires knowledge of the transactions, investment services, and ancillary investment services in question

requirements.title: balance
requirements.text: The company reached a balance sheet total of more than 20,000,000 € last year

requirements.title: revenue
requirements.text: The company generated sales revenue of more than 40,000,000 € last year

requirements.title: equity
requirements.text: The company has more than 2,000,000 € of its own funds

description.0: YES, I, {name}, shall be classified as a Professional Customer. Should the criteria confirmed above change, I, {name}, undertake to update them via the "My Account" area. At the request of the company, it is possible to reach an agreement on classification as a private customer within the meaning of the German Securities Trading Act. This agreement must be in writing.
description.1: Yes, the company {name} should be classified as a professional client. If the criteria confirmed above change, the company commits to updating them. Upon request, the company may also enter into an agreement to be classified as a retail client under the Securities Trading Act. This agreement must be in writing.

walletLinked.title: Connected Wallet
walletLinked.subtitle: Your wallet is ready to use on the platform.
walletLinked.intro: To store your tokens securely, you need a wallet. A wallet is a digital safe, similar to a deposit account, which you can access at any time via our dashboard. We provide the wallet free of charge through our partner Web3Auth.

tooltip.content:
Your wallet is protected using a secure system called multi-party computation (MPC).

Instead of storing a private key in one place, it's split across multiple parts and only comes together when you log in — meaning no one else (not even us) can access it.

No apps to install, no crypto knowledge needed — it just works.

This is powered by a technology called Web3Auth, which helps apps like ours create wallets without needing you to deal with private keys or crypto jargon.

walletLinked.outro: Once onboarding is complete and before investing, you can replace this wallet with one you created and manage externally. The wallet we've generated is yours alone — only you can access its private key — but we give you the freedom to use any wallet you already control.
